cells.quote: The study found some positive achievement impacts for schools that missed AYP, but not for schools that were identified for the first year of school improvement. Further, effects were not consistent across years and outcomes.
cells.note: The study used a regression discontinuity design; no printed effect size is provided in the study text above.

cells.quote: The study found some positive achievement impacts for schools that missed AYP, but not for schools that were identified for the first year of school improvement.
